notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.6 ver. 0.9.172
notes.content:
---------------------------------------------
Changelog delivery 24/03/2025
All these changes are available as:
Steam Build 17883465 (ver. 0.9.172)

For all platforms:

Others:
[list]
[*] Error when overwriting an existing saveslot and cancelling the action. Game still overwrites the save file
[/list]

---------------------------------------------
Changelog delivery 24/01/2025

All these changes are available in the patch 1.0.6 for Steam and NSW patch 1.0.3
For all platforms:

Gameplay:
[list]
[*] Fix: Glenn clips into his bed when getting up during the attack on Blossom
[*] Fix: Unable to find all 18 trash pirates in the Kiezel Fracture
[*] Fix: Gulliven's opening line gets cut off too quickly when approaching Stalkista
[*] Fix: Side quest marker can be seen on screen during scene approaching Stalkista
[*] Fix: No side quest waymarker back to Dead Rock at the end of "The Brother and the Dreamer"
[*] Fix: Lots of flickering when flying around Zabutyy Outpost in the overworld
[*] Fix: Game judders when flying through the wind wall tunnels
[*] Fix: Bucket's profile picture keeps disappearing in conversation after he joins the crew
[*] Fix: Unable to leave Zabutyy after completing the Ancient Ruins, leading to a progression blocker
[*] Fix: Scene with Garrote leaving the Furnauts replays if you return to Zabutyy, and can lead to a blocker
[*] Fix: Blocker if you click through the dialogue quickly during the scene when Glenn confronts Julian
[*] Fix: Issues with unlocking arts early in the game
[*] Fix: Have to unpause the game twice when returning to the game from the pause menu
[/list]

Combat:
[list]
[*] Fix: Enemy image incorrectly appeared as Vanessa during combat with an Alliance Airship
[*] Fix: Enemy airship invisible when attacked by the Aerius Purge art
[*] Fix: Camera struggles to stay focused on characters and enemies during multiple unique arts
[*] Fix: Issue with enemies healing each other during combat
[*] Fix: Entered combat just as was destroying an extractor in Yaatana led to a blocker
[*] Fix: Early game the hit percentages for machine gun attacks are far too low
[*] Fix: Allies and enemies often target incorrect characters during Yaatana
[*] Fix: Multiple issues when using Zenith's Death From Above art
[*] Fix: Enemies often get stuck in a loop of constant evading when on low health
[/list]

Others:
[list]
[*] Fix: No translation error in the in the combat section on the key bindings page
[*] Fix: Mouse wheel too sensitive on the Key Bindings page
[/list]

PC Only

Steam Deck:
[list]
[*] Fix: Intro animation and story intro do not play
[*] Fix: In game videos sometimes don't play properly on Steam Deck
[/list]

---------------------------------------------
Changelog delivery 14/01/2025
All these changes are available in the patch 1.0.6 for Steam and NSW patch 1.0.3

For all platforms:

Combat:
[list]
[*] Fix: Camera struggles to stay focused on characters and enemies during multiple unique arts
[*] Fix: Fio always gets given multiple buffs at the start of the second turn of combat
[/list]

Others:
[list]
[*] Fix: Audio alarm starts earlier in the cutscene of Esmeralda being triggered
[/list]

PC Only

Quests:
[list]
[*] Fix: Bucket achievement
[/list]

Others:
[list]
[*] Add: Cloud Save activated
[/list]

---------------------------------------------
Changelog delivery 13/12/2024
All these changes are available in the patch 1.0.4 for Steam and NSW patch 1.0.3

Combat:
[list]
[*] add: Implementing arsenal in Airship combat
[*] fix: SFX basic attack Airships does not exist
[*] fix: Errors using Cruel Wind (Any Level) on Alibatross and Lizardwaks
[*] fix: If we use Purify (Any level) on an Alibatross or Lizardhawk, the enemy will freeze while receiving the attack.
[*] fix: Errors with the unlocking and cost of arts
[*] fix: Restriction success of Art Unique 3 from Tomoko (S. E. Down)
[*] fix: Portrait of our character goes up if we cancel the selection of a target of an arsenal item.
[*] fix: Errors with ‘Angel of Fire LVL 2’ and ‘Inferno LVL 3’.
[*] fix: Errors with ‘Tempest’ and ‘Flood’.
[*] fix: Status effects icon stays on
[*] fix: Errors in Tomoko's Unique.
[*] fix: If we use the unique of Mica lvl2, the level icon will not be displayed because the name of the art is too long.
[/list]

General:
[list]
[*] add: at the end of the end credits, go to the Splash screen instead of the Title Screen
[*] fix: Doc incognito has no portrait in build
[/list]

Exploration:
[list]
[*] fix: Jittery Nimbus escape timeline
[/list]

---------------------------------------------
Changelog delivery 09/12/2024
All these changes are available in the patch 1.0.4 for Steam and NSW patch 1.0.3

General:
[list]
[*] fix: Speaking with Marco on our way to Nexus 3 creates a breaker
[*] fix: No SFX during intro cutscene
[*] Change: Added BGM: Shipyard Sneaking
[*] Change: Added BGM: Battle Anticipation
[*] Change: Traditional Chinese logo implemented
[*] fix: Visiting Edmund's airjet at Colmena on our way to Nexus 3 creates a breaker
[*] fix: Added localization for Resting and Overworld.
[*] Change: Added Traditional Chinese to Switch build (hidden)
[*] fix: Several character portraits not visible: Vernier, Julian (Blossom), Gulliven (Blossom), Nexus, Admiral Lehmann, Gigadrone
[/list]

Combat:
[list]
[*] fix: Target for Fio's Unique is in the incorrect position
[*] fix: UI wrongly shows Angel of Fire 1 when using AoF 2 or 3
[*] fix: Dillon's Unique lvl 2 and 3 do not show their VFX
[*] fix: Uniques do low damage (balance)
[*] fix: Alibatross and its HP bar invisible during Cryobeam animation
[*] fix: Glenn's Unique lvl.2 with out of position VFX, Unique lvl.3 with no VFX.
[*] fix: Lightning Shot lvl.1 and 2 has the shot coming from behind the airjet. Lvl.3 doesn't show the shot nor the enemy. 
[*] fix: Coriander's airjet is invisible during exploration and combat.
[*] fix: Lizardhawks have no animation during combat
[*] fix: Mira's Unique shows her transport immobile and target airjet invisible
[*] fix: Icon for Status Effect stays on
[*] fix: It is possible to perform two actions for the same pilot in a round if the player selects normal attack/art and then changes it to evade
[*] fix: Garrote's Unique shows Freezing round animation at any level.
[*] exploration and overworld:
[*] fix: Audio and Music cuts off during Stalkista
[*] fix: No SFX in cutscene when door opens to Dirfeather's lair
[/list]

Management:
[list]
[*] fix: Item Packs console errors
[/list]

---------------------------------------------
Changelog delivery 29/11/2024
All these changes are available in the patch 1.0.3 for Steam (and future NSW export)

For all platforms:

General:

[list]
[*] fix: "C" appears incorrectly when Bucket is talking to Glenn
[*] fix: Setting text in the top left is cut off after changing language to either French or German
[*] fix: Changing language doesn't update the Confirm or Close prompts
[*] fix: Close text appears twice on tutorials when using a controller
[*] fix: Tutorial for Garrote's smoke screen appears before combat where he isn't selectable
[*] fix: Skip's input not visible on credit screen
[*] fix: Returning to Glenn's room after leaving the house makes the camera stay still.
[*] fix: When pausing and then unpausing in a cinematic vignette, the text and dark filter remain active.
[*] fix: Two NPCs standing inside each other in Zabutyy Outpost[/list]

Settings:
[list][*] fix: The vertical speed sliders for both walkable and scan are set to 0.1 by default.
[*] fix: Selecting Reset on the Controls screen sets the Camera Speed to 0.1
[*] fix: Comma, full stop and hash key appear blanked when assigned on the Key Bindings page
[*] fix: Lower the default graphics settings, Full game and Demo
[/list]

Combat:
[list][*] fix: Combat results screen briefly flashes up every time you load into the overworld in the Nimbus
[*] fix: Combat UI errors if we use the status button when we are selecting art, attack target or arsenal item
[*] fix: If we use a healing item and an ally just dies, the item will be spent and we will have a member KO'd but his HP is not 0.
[*] Change: Cinematic acceleration input now is a toggle
[*] Add: Battle speed up tutorial
[*] Add: asset FFWD/X2 in combat cinematic acceleration
[*] Fix: When using the acceleration of the combat cinematic, when we attack a normal attack, only the first hit will be shown (we still hit 3 but only 1 is shown).
[*] fix: Advantage does not work in Airships combat.
[*] fix: Text description cut off for the Thunder-Proof item
[*] fix: Issue seen with the Toxic Round art
[*] fix: The coriander undead ship is not visible in exploration or combat.
[*] Fix: Blank screen after spending a turn in Stone Forest[/list]

Exploration and Overworld:
[list][*] Change: Mica's ability lasts for a given time activated.
[*] fix: Alibatros do not seem to detect the player in Grinding
[*] fix: If from the Nimbus we go out to the OW, the speedometer looks black.
[*] fix: Timeline errors in Blossom battle
[*] fix: Zombie Airjets fly rotated 90° in exploration (Gates of Oblivion)
[*] fix: Screenshot for the Hunting Grounds 2 is incorrect[/list]

Quests:
[list][*] fix: Lizardhawk Breast not dropped on grinding 3
[*] fix: Text gets cut off after completing a side quest
[*] fix: Failing any of the first Nexus trials will restart you back in the Nimbus outside the Nexus[/list]

Management:
[list]
[*] fix: No way to remove the custom map marker when viewing the map
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v.0.9.160b
notes.content:
[b]Hi everyone! [/b]

Thank you all for the support during the launch of Sky Oceans: Wings for Hire! Since launching the game last week, we have gathered community feedback and built a large patch for PC players including bug fixes, updates, and general balancing. 

[b]You can find an extensive list of fixes added to the game in patch 0.9.160b below:  [/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the camera during the ‘Blossom Battle’ meetup.
[*] Updated Zenith’s beaviour tree to make it more aggressive.
[*] Fixed an issue where blacktooth portraits did not display correctly.
[*] Updated ‘Purgatory Mines’ to add a health kit before the boss fight.
[*] Updated the scout and transport behaviour trees to adjust healing support and self preservation trees to avoid excessive healing.
[*] Updated Zenith’s ‘Analysis Tree’ to avoid him from repeatedly helaing allies.
[*] Fixed the player position on the map when it was over the ‘Forgotten Outpost’.
[*] Updated Zenith’s ‘Unique’ to visualize Airship damage.
[*] Updated the Nexus 1 puzzles to fix issues were random enemies would spawn and fix the laser grid speed.
[*] Updated the ‘Purgatory Mines’ yarnscript to update BGM calls.
[*] Updated the ‘Wlk_Esmeralda’ to adjust the player camera.
[*] Updated the ‘Input’ config for ‘Standard Navigation’ to increase the mouse camera rotation speed.
[*] Updated the exploration scenes to revert the camera’s FOV settings to prefab values.
[*] Fixed an issue where the resting pilot did not finish resting after finishing its required combat.
[*] Fixed an issue where Doc’s panel did not update when first opened.
[*] Added ‘Chicken Prefab’ to roaming.
[*] Added the ‘Not Dead Yet’ function to revive an ally reactively.
[*] Fixed the item restore plus effect instance id value because it was generating a breaker.
[*] Added tasks amount to quest save data.
[*] Fixed the ‘Not Dead Yet’ status effect, arts, and item that used it to apply the intended effect by design.
[*] Add a UI indicator and Sfx for ‘Not Dead Yet’ status effect revival.
[*] Updated the ‘Gigadrone Balance’ to fix breaker.
[*] Added quest elements amount to save data.
[*] Fixed an issue where default gameplay settings did not apply at the begginning of the game.
[*] Updated the Gigadrone deck HP stat.
[*] Fixed an error on the ‘Not Dead Yet’ activation SFX blocking build creation.
[*] Updated ‘CombatConfigurations’ asset to re-balance combat psyche effects.
[*] Fixed an error causing a missing airship in Aerius purge.
[*] Fixed an error when healing airships on first load.
[*] Fixed an error where airships started with 0 HP on ‘Stone Forest’ combat.
[*] Fixed an error where players were not allowed to make Vanessa reparations.
[*] Fixed status effect ‘Blessed’.
[*] Fixed a breaker cuaing extreme lagging ‘Shipyard Battle’.
[*] Fixed issues on the desembarking panel.
[*] Added SFX feedback when players cannot enter an island.
[*] Fixed an error where status effects were not applying during the first use on build.
[*] Updated ‘Stone Forest’ to address flow issues reported on Steam.
[*] Updated ‘Hunting Areas’ Content.
[*] Fixed localisation issues with Skill Points abbreviations.
[*] Updated the Credits Video to fix Stephen’s role.
[*] Fixed key rebinding issues.
[*] Fixed localisation issues in the Spanish version.
[*] Fixed the ‘9 Lives’ status effect.
[*] Fixed the missing character portraits.
[*] Fixed multiple grammar issues.
[*] Fixed balancing issues during the Sven battle.
[*] Fixed Sven’s Unique Art.
[*] Fixed visual issues with the ‘Undead Bomber’.
[*] Fixed visual issues with Sven’s Unique Art.
[*] Fixed visual issues with Gigadrone’s Unique Art.
[*] Fixed a culling error in ‘Training Grounds’.
[*] Fixed ‘Antimater Cannon’ visual issues.
[*] Fixed ‘Airship EMP Cannon’ ability issues.
[*] Fixed visual issues with ‘Airship Support System’ art.
[*] Fixed visual issues with ‘Fire Controlman’ art.
[*] Updated the ‘Exploration Navigation Tutorial’ to show Glenn’s Threat Scanner first.
[*] Updated the ‘Training Grounds’ to remove ghost task indicators.
[*] Fixed an issue causing Glenn to render as a plain model in some versions of his home.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing the airjet landing cutscene to play at ‘Blossom Graveyard’.
[*] Updated the ‘Auto Save Config’ to ensure that all versions of the  ‘Nexus Dungeons’ and ‘Blossom Battle’ allows players to restart the level, instead of going back further.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing Side Quests concerning creature hunting from getting completed.
[*] Fixed an issue with exploration UI displaying during combat when unpausing the game.
[*] Fixed an issue with combat confirmation binding.
[/list]
Octecto & PQube Teams

notes.title: Sky Oceans: Wings for Hire Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]Ahoy Sky Pirates,[/h2]

We hope you're enjoying the demo! For those who have already played it, we've added fixes based on your feedback and there's a full list of updates below:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused text to advance during cutscenes too slow, and also occasionally cut off too quickly. Players can now control the text advance speed
[*] Balanced the combat difficult, especially in earlier stages early on. The combat difficulty has been addressed.
[*] Addressed several issues with character and airjet movement. Airjets now show a small thruster animation when hovering and secondary controls are also an option (Simulation Controls).
[*] Fixed recovery Items being way too low. The basic recovery item is now worth 100 hp.
[*] Adressed the movement inside Glenn's house being too slow. The player now moves quicker in the house and can run outside as default.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were unable to use arts on the final turn against Mira or Leonard. The player is now able to use arts in all battles.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera is too close and too fast on default. The camera position has now been address to make it further away from the player.
[/list]

Thank you to all of the players providing feedback as we continue to work on the game.


Octecto & PQube Teams
